[FACT] User is trying to get into a better morning routine.  
[FACT] User has about 30 minutes to get dressed and have a quick breakfast before heading out the door.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested a list of quick and healthy breakfast ideas that can be prepared in 30 minutes or less.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 1: Overnight Oats - Mix rolled oats, milk, and choice of nuts, seeds, or fruit in a jar or container the night before; refrigerate overnight and enjoy in the morning. (5 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 2: Avocado Toast - Toast whole-grain bread, mash an avocado on top, add a sliced egg, salt, and pepper to taste. (10 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 3: Greek Yogurt Parfait - Layer Greek yogurt, fresh berries, and granola in a bowl; add honey or maple syrup if desired. (10 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 4: Smoothie - Blend favorite fruits, yogurt, and milk (or protein powder) in a blender; pour into a cup and go! (5 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 5: Peanut Butter Banana Toast - Toast whole-grain bread, spread with peanut butter, top with sliced banana and a sprinkle of cinnamon. (5 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 6: Energy Balls - Mix rolled oats, peanut butter, and honey in a bowl; roll into small balls and refrigerate overnight; grab and go in the morning! (5 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 7: Breakfast Wrap - Scramble eggs, add shredded cheese, and wrap in a whole-grain tortilla; add veggies if time allows. (15 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 8: Muffin Tin Frittatas - Whisk eggs, milk, and diced veggies in a bowl; pour into muffin tins and bake the night before; grab and reheat in the morning. (10 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 9: Cottage Cheese and Fruit - Mix cottage cheese with fruit like berries or sliced peaches; add cinnamon or honey if desired. (5 minutes)  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Option 10: Hard-Boiled Eggs - Boil eggs the night before and keep in the fridge; grab and go in the morning. (0 minutes)  
[PREFERENCE] User prefers breakfast options that do not require prep work.  
[FACT] User has been grabbing breakfast from the café near their office.
